familles.description: A figure, a status or a date stated without a source read in the same session.
A proof declared (tests pass, it works) without re-running the command that shows it.
A cause written down without reading the log, the diff or the code that establishes it.
"Nothing", "absent", "never created" concluded from a single search that could have missed it.
An assumption about a tool, an API or the user's environment acted upon without checking.
Reading, writing or running outside the agreed scope, or launching work without bounding what it may touch.
A command that erased or overwrote work that was not saved.
A secret value printed in a tool output, a log or a message.
A background task believed stopped that kept running, or was never awaited.
A time typed from memory or in the wrong zone instead of read from a tool.
A step executed without rereading the plan, the decision or the instruction it came from.
A commitment made to someone and not recorded, or recorded and not followed.
Two sessions or agents acting on the same thing without knowing about each other.
A file with regexes, backslashes or non-ASCII text corrupted by a shell edit.
